about: Final gold suyari clouds of the film (owner WP-03; contract for WP-06's road-works bands). Each entry is one tier: top edge y, height h, extreme ends x0..x1 (tips included), normalised to the frame, y down. Tiers that overlap vertically form one cloud (three clouds). Ends taper to a spear tip (すやり霞): for a pixel at distance d from the nearer end, t = clamp(d / L, 0, 1) with L = min(taper * h * H, (x1 - x0) * W / 2) (frame-height pixels), s = sin(PI/2 * t)^power; the tip sits at y + apex*h, the top edge at (y + apex*h) - apex*h*s, the bottom edge at (y + apex*h) + (1 - apex)*h*s. Ends beyond the frame lie wholly off-frame. Colour = plate 8 at 50 % over --paper (the P_8 tint), flat, crisp edges. src/film/scene/end-band-path.ts turns a tier into an SVG path.
